summary_en: ¥9,999,966,900 block acquisition of 8,916,600 shares (1.83% of S/O ex-treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-05 at ¥1,121.50 per share. Settlement post-trade. Remainder of authorized ¥10B program (9M shares authorized 2026-05-13) to be acquired via open market through 2026-09-30.
title_en: Notice regarding purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-04, ALSOK announced execution of a block repurchase via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-08-05 at 08:45 JST. The block comprises 8,916,600 shares (1.83% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) at ¥1,121.50 per share, for a total outlay of ¥9,999,966,900 (within the ¥10 billion upper limit approved by the board on 2026-05-13). Results will be published immediately after the trading session closes. Any shortfall in this block against the authorized limit will be made up via open-market purchases through 2026-09-30.
